# PROFILE
I am a dedicated fourth-year HBO Life Sciences student at Hogeschool Utrecht, specialising 
in Biomolecular Research. My background spans molecular biology, protein biochemistry 
and data analysis, with hands-on experience in techniques including SDS-PAGE, Western 
blot, mass spectrometry, and PCR. I have contributed to research projects in both academic 
and applied settings, and I am comfortable working independently as well as in a team. I am 
looking for an internship where I can apply and deepen my laboratory skills within a 
professional research environment with a particular interest in molecular biology, proteomics 
or clinical diagnostics.
